notes.title: Unveiling Post-Apocalyptic Chaos!
notes.content:
Dear players, we have just updated our game! ːsteamhappyː

The following improvement have been made to our latest update of Chapter Wars version 2.7:

 Improved UI Main Menu
 Nickname registration function
 Improved multiplayer interaction and environment optimisation
 Added a new map of Post Apocalypse with interactive residential environment and new AI Zombies


Post Apocalypse map
As the radioactive levels have subsided gradually, outlaws now seek to establish their bases on previously populated villages, little did they know that the same population now mutated to the extreme! Some of the machinery once used to be of help turned over time against their creators roaming the open space post apocalypse to cause mayhem to anyone they detect living or undead.
